summary_en: This study tests zanzalintinib, alone or with pembrolizumab plus berahyaluronidase alfa, compared with placebo, in people with stage II or III colorectal cancer that has molecular residual disease after definitive therapy. Zanzalintinib is taken as an oral tablet once daily, and pembrolizumab with berahyaluronidase alfa is given as a subcutaneous injection every 3 weeks, for up to 2 years. The study measures effectiveness compared with placebo as its primary objective; the specific outcome measure is not stated, and this is a Phase 3 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa zanzalintinib, solo o junto con pembrolizumab más berahyaluronidase alfa, comparado con placebo, en personas con cáncer colorrectal en etapa II o III con enfermedad residual molecular después del tratamiento definitivo. Zanzalintinib se toma como tableta oral una vez al día, y pembrolizumab con berahyaluronidase alfa se aplica como inyección subcutánea cada 3 semanas, durante hasta 2 años. El estudio mide la efectividad comparada con placebo como objetivo principal; la medida específica del resultado no se indica, y es un estudio de fase 3.
who_for: Stage II or III colon or rectal adenocarcinoma with completed definitive therapy.
Local test shows MSS, MSI-low, or pMMR status.
Positive for circulating tumor DNA on local Natera Signatera MRD test.
No radiographic evidence of disease on baseline CT or MRI scans.
not_for: Prior treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitors or VEGFR inhibitors.
History of solid organ or allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Another cancer that is progressing or needed active treatment within 2 years.
Colorectal cancer that needed systemic therapy before definitive therapy.
Systemic anticancer or radiation therapy after completing definitive therapy.
